questions.text:
Name these:
1. Five kingdoms under the recent scheme of classification.
2. Five division of kingdom plantar.
extractionIssues: Group total [4] printed for both items; no per-item marks

questions.text:
Fill in the blanks.
a) The first antibiotic penicillin was discovered by ____.
b) ____ is a unicellular fungus.
c) The curd from which moisture has been removed termed as ____.
d) The hormone ____ was the first substance produced by Escherichia coli.
extractionIssues: Group total [4] printed for all four blanks; no per-item marks

questions.text:

i. Define the terms.
a) Denitrification b) Nitrification
